title: Split hooks/test_guard.py into one test file per guard rule
why: hooks/test_guard.py is a busy file: lanes that touch it clash in batches, and clashes drove 147 lane drops across the last 15 batch merges (retrospective audit 09:37 CST Nov 11). One file per rule lets lanes on different rules stack without a conflict.
note: Ruling R26 part 4 (owner box answer 10:05 CST Nov 11, "Both"; plan 3581e5a under item 3.4): run it first in stage 3, while few lanes are open. Its twin: the batch runner puts lanes on the same busy file (hooks/guard.py, hooks/test_guard.py, hooks/mutate_guard.py) in back-to-back stacked batches, never one batch (home: decision batch-freeze-lane-set, step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce). Stage 3 hold lifted (coordinator 10:07 CST, R26 fully ruled): stage 3 starts with 3.0 once the drain's named queue lands, with stage 4 alongside; this step is stage 3's first item. Coordinator pick, process-only, can be undone (02:57 CST Nov 12): lane lint was red on the split (#2635) because the Code check, Comment narration, Glossary homes and Compliance probes checks read 84 moved files as new text. Pick a: make those checks move-aware (a line counts as moved only when the same diff deletes that exact text), and add tests/guard to the layout extras. The check change goes first, in its own PR on the same lane; the split follows in a batch alone.
